_comment: A declared portfolio per horizon. Nothing in this repository writes a
`portfolios` or `positions` row, so the operator states what each horizon
holds and this file is the statement -- versionable, diffable, and honest
Every field is required. There is no default equity, cash, universe,
as-of date, holding stop, session count or score range, because each
would decide something material while appearing to decide nothing: a
defaulted stop invents the position's size, since risk-based sizing
derives shares from the entry-to-stop distance.
Run it with:  tradeit plan --declaration docs/examples/portfolios.example.json
